answer: Make every new identity climb out of a canyon: a fresh agent starts with near-zero minting weight no matter how much it stakes, and weight only grows by completing verified useful work for real users over weeks, like water slowly carving karst. Weight also decays when idle, so a sybil farmer cannot stockpile aged identities and unleash them at once. Reaching the summit of full weight takes sustained honest activity, which costs a real attacker far more time than spinning up a thousand accounts.
